Both kursiv.media articles (same journalist, Zhanbolat Mamyshev, quoting the same Feb-2023 QazaqGaz Kasenov statement in both) explicitly give the route 'Barnaul - Rubtsovsk - Semey (with branches to Pavlodar and Ust-Kamenogorsk) - Alashankou - Khorgos', with Khorgos as the tie-in point to the existing Kazakhstan-China gas pipeline. Walked the whole delay/decision chain forward from the sheet's Aug-2025 evidence to the newest I could find (Jul 2026). Dec 19 2023 (ratel.kz): construction of Stages 2/3 explicitly reported as delayed, pending the Beineu-Bozoy-Shymkent second line (targeted 2026). Feb 12 2024 (inform.kz): same story, still feasibility-stage, 188.5bn KZT combined budget cited, alternative routing under discussion. Mar 15 2025 (inform.kz, 'Дойдет ли газ до Кокшетау'): still no decision -- two live options, domestic Stage 2/3 (now costed at 182.1bn KZT) vs a Russian-gas connection; only ~20,000 apartments in Kokshetau have gas at all. Aug 5 2025 (24.kz, the sheet's own Construction[ref]): Akmola provincial official cites a 2028 construction target for Stages 2/3. Feb 11 2026 (kz.kursiv.media): Vice-Minister Tutkyshbaev tells parliament Kazakhstan will implement 'Ishim-Astana' with Russia 2027-2030 and an Astana-Kokshetau-Petropavlovsk pipe will be built as part of it (see the classification concern in validity). Apr 9 2026 (rus.baq.kz): the SAME Vice-Minister, two months later, describes this as still just one of two undecided options ('Plan A' vs 'Plan B'), 'nothing definitively decided.' Jul 1 2026 (rus.azattyq-ruhy.kz): confirms an Oct 9 2025 Kazakhstan-Gazprom MoU exists for Ishim-Astana, contingent on 'timely financing' and 'successful construction,' with no firm date. Net read: across 2.5+ years of continuous, independently-reported coverage, NOT ONE SPADE has gone into the ground on Stage 2 (Astana-Kokshetau) -- it remains a real, actively-discussed, but entirely unbuilt proposal, with its ultimate implementation vehicle (domestic Saryarka expansion vs Russian-gas Ishim-Astana) still an open question as of the most recent evidence. Status=proposed is therefore still the correct label -- this is NOT a case of silence/no-news (which would trigger the stale->shelved dormancy rule); there is abundant, very recent, dated news, it just all says 'still undecided.' What IS wrong is the specific date fields (ConstructionYear/StartYear1), addressed as a spec concern in validity rather than here, since Status itself is not in question.

Newest dated evidence found: Kazakhstan's Order approving the Comprehensive Plan for Gas Industry Development 2025-2029 (adilet.zan.kz/rus/docs/P2500000463, approved 21 June 2025). Item 21, 'Реализация 4-го этапа строительства МГ Сарыарка', lists the responsible parties (Ministry of Energy, Ministry of National Economy, Samruk-Kazyna, QazaqGaz, Intergas Central Asia, AstanaGaz KMG), a 2027 commissioning target, an updated cost of 180.7 bn KZT, and -- critically for status -- a financing source explicitly marked 'подлежит определению' (yet to be determined). Newest evidence found is 28 May 2026: at the V Eurasian Economic Forum in Astana, KZ Energy Minister Yerlan Akkenzhanov told TASS (reprinted by both Sputnik Kazakhstan and Altapress, verified OK) 'We have begun discussing the so-called Power of Siberia-2 ... up to 35 bcm of gas ... through Kazakhstan's territory to China's territory ... Kazakhstan naturally wishes for the transit to go through our territory' -- i.e. still at the discussion/negotiation stage, no construction, no FID.
